# Operations Data Platform

## Executive Summary

The company runs its scheduling and quoting on spreadsheets, and the cost of that
shows up in three places a platform can reach.

## Financial Analysis

### Current State

The company reported LTM revenue of $84.0M and adjusted EBITDA of $12.6M, an
adjusted EBITDA margin of 15.0% for the same period.

Average quote turnaround runs 9 days against an industry norm nearer three, and
on-time delivery sits at 71% across the last four quarters.

Gross margin ran 38.2% in the first half and 34.9% in the second, and the paper
states no single figure for the year.

Schedulers rebuild the weekly plan by hand every Monday, and the rebuild takes
roughly eleven hours of senior operator time.

Quotes are priced off a spreadsheet last revised two years ago, so margin on
repeat work drifts without anyone seeing it.

No one can say which jobs lost money until the quarter closes.

### Projected Impact

| Case | Incremental Annual EBITDA | EBITDA Margin Impact (pp) |
|---|---|---|
| Conservative | $1.4M | 1.7pp |
| Base Case | $2.6M | 3.1pp |
| Optimistic | $4.1M | 4.9pp |

Quote turnaround falls to 2 days once pricing rules are digitized, and on-time
delivery reaches 92% at steady state.

## The Proposed Solution

The platform gives schedulers a single live plan they can change without
rebuilding it, so the Monday rebuild stops.

Pricing rules move out of the spreadsheet and into a rules engine every quote is
priced against.

Job-level margin is visible the day the job closes rather than at quarter end.

### Technical Requirements

The build runs in three phases against the systems already in place.

## Implementation Approach

### Timeline

| Phase | Timeline | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| **Phase 1: Scheduling Foundation** | Months 1-3 | Stand up the live schedule and retire the Monday rebuild |
| **Phase 2: Pricing Rules** | Months 3-6 | Move pricing out of the spreadsheet and into the rules engine |
| **Phase 3: Margin Visibility** | Months 6-12 | Close the loop with job-level margin reporting at close |

Prose omitted.
